limits: Machine policy evidence, not human win-rate or commercial balance.
Pre-equipped fixtures assert chapter rarity, upgrade, grid, power, protocol and standard purchase/upgrade cost limits; they do not prove actual shop acquisition probability.
Budgets use 70% of earned kill pools before each boss: 165.4, 399.4, 702 scrap; free starters and sale refunds are not deducted from fixture cost.

Act one uses no rare railgun/missile: ballistic and oil builds are explicitly transitional. A single drone hive and relay are uncommon and can appear in act one; the double-hive build starts in act two.
No HP/invulnerability edits, damage multipliers, direct victory, clock multipliers, or skipped simulation steps.
The policy sees a 960×720 world-unit viewport and current enemies, previews and hostile projectiles, not future boss plans.
Acts one/two use the initially available scavenger. Act three retains design chassis, assuming prior account unlocks; fixtures start at normal chassis HP and do not model previous-wave damage.
